sentences.en: By 1898 the imperial will, working under partially new conditions, produced continual chaos, and by 1900 succeeded in practically overriding all constitutional restraints.

sentences.en: For Stubbs, brought up in the English town of Bedford, the overriding passion of his own adolescence was cars.

sentences.en: This is because both legal and equitable easements are overriding interests.
